reviews.decision: The exact stable public NgZone import supplies the required second constructor parameter in the unchanged authentic16 eight-argument constructor. Its service value remains available for Angular DI; no erased-only or nominal generic-token argument is inferred. Checker binding finds one required type reference, one same-object forwarding into the owned ripple renderer and exactly the public run, onStable and readonly isStable accesses. Complete current and untouched16 chip classes execute with genuine original and both minimum public zone namespaces in ten isolated development/production subjects, including current public zoneful/zoneless application providers. The consumed member declarations are stable/nondeprecated; strict compilation checks the actual blur method and six negative contracts against each complete public namespace. Current blur releases the owned request before entering run and emitting the chip identity, preserving the historical zoneful deferred form-state behavior. The existing stable fallback handles the genuine zoneless provider, which emits no stability event. Destroy/refocus/replacement cancellation, post-destroy rejection, synchronous host focus and real FormControl touch propagation pass100 protocol cases. Seventy-six behavioral faults and authentic before-focus-repair counterexamples reject incorrect context/timing/cancellation/refocus, independently of source hashes. The renderer records the identical supplied public zone, and no current private or compatibility-only API is imported. Traits, ripple renderer, DOM, platform and CDR remain explicit collaborators; only eight complete list members execute. Actual legacy component factories/node DI, native focus/layout/styles, complete renderer behavior, packed/AOT/browser/consumer and full compiler/Node/RxJS floors stay pending. The pre-existing direct historical chip-blur wrapper also needs its source-context repair; this new current proof does not replace or qualify that original program. The current raw focus inspector now explicitly qualifies the independently tested tab body/adapter source delta. The chip class, all NgZone accesses and the original focus/blur lifetime remain byte-identical; the inspector still hashes every remaining product/reference/fixture member and requires the same original focus protocol. This rebinds evidence only and grants no native,packed,floor or G11 credit. The independently tested public snack DOM dispatch and host recovery repair changes only attachDomPortal. The other31 complete class members,constructors,imports and product resources remain identical. This successor retains the original role decision and evidence; it does not qualify full component,native,packed or floor execution.
